title: faircdi row schema
description: Row-level schema for CDI/faircdi.csv.gz in the fairadi-data release snapshot.

cdiraw.description: Raw CDI score derived from the first principal component before year-wise rescaling.

cdistd.description: Standardized CDI score after rescaling the raw score within year.

faircdi.description: National percentile ranking of the CDI score within year.
